concept.title: STOP-MOTION GRAPHIC STORM
concept.description: Ultra-dense stop-motion motion-graphics. Photographic character treated as paper cut-out. Hard graphic collage (geometric layers, bold color fields, ink edges) explodes around him. New hard visual event every 1.0 second. Zero breathing room.

character_identity_lock.reference_role: Attached @Image1 4-panel sheet is absolute identity source (face, profile, front, back).

identity.face: Dense dark beard & mustache, strong jaw, light brown eyes, olive skin
identity.clothing: Black button-up overshirt open over white crew tee, black slim jeans
identity.accessories: Black cap with green underbrim, black leather boots

character_identity_lock.color_rule: Character colors locked (black/white/green). Only graphic layers may add flat color.
character_identity_lock.core_concept: Photographic paper cut-out manipulated by stop-motion graphic layers
character_identity_lock.physics_rules: Hard paper edges only. Character moves exclusively on 1s hard cuts. No soft morphing.

camera_direction.shot_type: Locked frames + aggressive hard cuts every 1.0s
camera_direction.camera_journey: Static frames only. All motion from hard graphic cuts, paper rearrangements and color-block wipes using the four reference angles as discrete cut-outs.

visual_style.overall: High-contrast stop-motion paper-cut collage motion graphics
color_palette: Flat primaries only on graphic layers
visual_style.materials_and_texture: Visible paper fiber edges, stop-motion jitter, hard geometry, ink-splatter edges, layered cut-out depth. No gradients, no photo backgrounds.

motion_language.kick: Every 1.0s kick forces hard cut or new paper layer slam
motion_language.wooden_snare: Triggers geometric shards, color wipes or multi-panel reconfigs
motion_language.sub_bass: Sustains current collage until next kick

beats.description: Extreme face close-up slammed on pure white. Green underbrim only color. Black geometric triangles with paper edges.
Hard cut to left profile full-body. Black vertical wipe reveals figure on flat green. Paper fiber edges on silhouette.
Hard cut front full-body. Sharp geometric paper shards fly in and lock as graphic frame around character.
Hard cut back view. Ink-edge explosion radiates from center. Character stays locked.
Hard cut face close-up. Bold kinetic type ‘CUT’ masks lower third in torn black paper letters.
Hard cut front. Four reference views appear as small floating paper panels orbiting in stop-motion steps.
Hard 2×2 multi-panel of all four angles with thick black paper borders.
Hard cut inverted silhouette on pure green. Paper-tear edges run across the figure.
Three rapid hard cuts cycling profile→front→back inside the 1s beat.
Front locked center. Graphic layers erupt into black/white/green color-block storm. Figure stays sharp.
Large kinetic type ‘STORM’ punches from bottom in heavy black paper letters. Never overlaps character.
Hard cut to pure black. All elements gone in one clean stop-motion cut.

negative_prompt: No extra limbs or clothing color changes
No photo backgrounds or realistic environments
No gradients or soft shadows on graphics
No Chinese characters or random text
No slow pacing — hard visual event every second
